rules.description: All YES-mandatory fields must be populated. Any blank value fails Fed edit checks.
rules.error_message: Mandatory field is blank — cannot be submitted

rules.description: All date fields must be valid calendar dates and not be future dates.
rules.error_message: Date field contains invalid or future date

rules.description: Origination FICO score must be between 300 and 850. Values of 0 or 999 are system placeholder defaults.
rules.error_message: fico_score_orig is outside valid range 300-850 or is a system placeholder value (0 or 999)

rules.description: Current FICO score must be between 300 and 850 when populated.
rules.error_message: fico_score_current is outside valid range 300-850

rules.description: property_state must be a valid 2-letter USPS postal code.
rules.error_message: property_state is not a valid US state or territory code

rules.description: property_zip must be exactly 5 numeric digits including leading zeros.
rules.error_message: property_zip is not a valid 5-digit ZIP code

rules.description: orig_loan_amount must be a positive whole dollar amount greater than zero.
rules.error_message: orig_loan_amount must be greater than 0

rules.description: original_ltv must be between 0.01 and 1.05. LTV above 1.05 exceeds Fed maximum.
rules.error_message: original_ltv is outside allowed range 0.01 to 1.05

rules.description: Schedule A covers first lien mortgages only. lien_position must equal 1.
rules.error_message: lien_position must be 1 for Schedule A — first lien only

rules.description: Reported original_ltv must equal orig_loan_amount divided by orig_property_value within tolerance of 0.01.
rules.error_message: LTV mismatch — reported LTV does not match computed LTV (loan amount / property value). Difference exceeds 0.01 tolerance

rules.description: first_payment_date must be after loan_closing_date by 15 to 75 days.
rules.error_message: first_payment_date is not after loan_closing_date or gap is outside 15-75 day range

rules.rule_name: CLTV Must Be Greater Than or Equal to LTV
rules.description: When original_cltv is populated it must be greater than or equal to original_ltv.
rules.error_message: original_cltv is less than original_ltv — combined LTV cannot be less than first lien LTV

rules.rule_name: DTI Back-End Greater Than or Equal to Front-End
rules.description: When both DTI fields are populated back-end DTI must be greater than or equal to front-end DTI.
rules.error_message: dti_back_end_orig is less than dti_front_end_orig — back-end DTI must be greater than or equal to front-end

rules.rule_name: Interest Type vs Product Type Consistency
rules.description: ARM products (4,5,6) must have interest_type_orig = 2. Fixed products (1,2,3) must have interest_type_orig = 1.
rules.error_message: interest_type_orig is inconsistent with product_type_orig — ARM product must be Variable rate and Fixed product must be Fixed rate

rules.rule_name: Fixed Rate Consistency Current vs Original
rules.description: For fixed-rate loans with no modification current interest rate must equal original interest rate.
rules.error_message: Fixed-rate loan has current_interest_rate different from orig_interest_rate with no recorded modification

rules.rule_name: IO Flag vs IO Term Consistency
rules.description: If io_flag_orig is N then io_term_orig_months must be 0. If io_flag_orig is Y then io_term_orig_months must be greater than 0.
rules.error_message: io_flag_orig and io_term_orig_months are inconsistent

rules.rule_name: Balloon Flag vs Balloon Term Consistency
rules.description: If balloon_flag is Y then balloon_term_months must be populated and greater than 0. If balloon_flag is N then balloon_term_months must be null.
rules.error_message: balloon_flag and balloon_term_months are inconsistent

rules.rule_name: UPB Cannot Exceed Original Loan Amount
rules.description: Current unpaid principal balance must not exceed the original loan amount.
rules.error_message: upb_current exceeds orig_loan_amount — UPB cannot be greater than original loan amount

rules.rule_name: Bankruptcy Chapter Required When Flag is Y
rules.description: If bankruptcy_flag is Y then bankruptcy_chapter must be populated. If bankruptcy_flag is N then bankruptcy_chapter must be blank.
rules.error_message: bankruptcy_flag is Y but bankruptcy_chapter is blank — chapter code is required

rules.rule_name: Foreclosure Referral Date Required When In Foreclosure
rules.description: If foreclosure_status is 1 or higher then foreclosure_referral_date must be populated. If foreclosure_status is 0 this field must be blank.
rules.error_message: foreclosure_status indicates loan is in foreclosure but foreclosure_referral_date is blank

rules.rule_name: Modification Type vs Loss Mitigation Status Consistency
rules.description: If loss_mitigation_status is 0 then modification_type must be 0. If modification_type is greater than 0 then loss_mitigation_status must not be 0.
rules.error_message: modification_type and loss_mitigation_status are inconsistent — modified loan must have active loss mitigation status

rules.description: For portfolio loans fico_date_current must be within 90 days of the reporting month. Stale FICO fails quarterly refresh requirement.
rules.error_message: fico_date_current is more than 90 days before reporting period — current FICO score must be refreshed quarterly

rules.description: reporting_asof_month must be in YYYYMM format and represent a valid calendar month between 2010 and 2 years in the future.
rules.error_message: reporting_asof_month is not a valid YYYYMM format or falls outside expected range
